item.title: Key Highlights of the SEBI (Issue and Listing of Non-Convertible Securities) (Amendment) Regulations, 2026
item.description: SEBI has notified SEBI (Issue and Listing of Non-Convertible Securities) (Amendment) Regulations, 2026 focusing on Retail Investor recognition with a ₹2 lakh investment limit and issuer incentives. The post Key Highlights of the SEBI (Issue and Listing of Non-Convertible Securities) (Amendment) Regulations, 2026 appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Railway employee travelling on Privilege Pass held bona fide passenger; Bombay HC grants Rs 3 lakh compensation despite missing journey entries
item.description: “Merely because an employee holding a valid pass fails to mention details himself, it cannot be held that he was travelling without a valid pass.” The post Railway employee travelling on Privilege Pass held bona fide passenger; Bombay HC grants Rs 3 lakh compensation despite missing journey entries appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Delhi High Court restrains large-scale job scam involving misuse of “AKASA AIR” trademark; issues directives
item.description: “The balance of convenience lies in favour of the Plaintiff, and if the Defendants are not restrained, the Plaintiff would suffer irreparable injury which cannot be adequately compensated in terms of money.” The post Delhi High Court restrains large-scale job scam involving misuse of “AKASA AIR” trademark; issues directives appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: ‘Granting maintenance would be grave injustice’; Allahabad HC denies woman’s claim after her brother shot her husband, leaving him incapacitated
item.description: “If a wife, by her own acts or omissions, causes or contributes to the incapacity of her husband to earn, she cannot be permitted to take advantage of such a situation and claim maintenance.” The post ‘Granting maintenance would be grave injustice’; Allahabad HC denies woman’s claim after her brother shot her husband, leaving him incapacitated appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: “Way forward is not radical reinvention but institutional course correction”: Justice N.V. Ramana speaks at Day 1 of the 4th ILA Conference
item.description: Day 1 of the much-awaited 4th ILA Conference featured erudite addresses and insights from leading insolvency experts and distinguished dignitaries on insolvency law and policy, global trends in restructuring, the changing geopolitical landscape, and cinema as a lens and mirror for the economy. The post “Way forward is not radical reinvention but institutional course correction”: Justice N.V. Ramana speaks at Day 1 of the 4th ILA Conference appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Register Now for the 3rd IBBI-INSOL India International Conclave!
item.description: Insolvency and Bankruptcy Board of India and INSOL India are hosting their 3rd International Conclave on 28th Jan 2026 at Le Meridien, New Delhi. The post Register Now for the 3rd IBBI-INSOL India International Conclave! appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Experts deliberate on entrepreneurship, risk and second chances at Day 2 of the 4th ILA Conference
item.description: Day 2 of the much-awaited 4th ILA Conference brought together eminent voices from India and abroad to examine insolvency law through the lens of entrepreneurship, risk-taking, and the importance of dignified second chances. The post Experts deliberate on entrepreneurship, risk and second chances at Day 2 of the 4th ILA Conference appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: From Group Insolvency to Modified Universalism: Experts provide insights on Day 2 of the 4th ILA Conference
item.description: Taking Day 2 of the 4th Insolvency Law Academy (“ILA”) Annual Conference further, the panellists and guests delved into topics such as cross-border insolvency, future of restructuring, group insolvency, hybrid insolvency, and much more. The post From Group Insolvency to Modified Universalism: Experts provide insights on Day 2 of the 4th ILA Conference appeared first on SCC Times.
